questions.stem: Two parents are both carriers of cystic fibrosis (Cc). What is the probability of their child having cystic fibrosis?
questions.explanation: If both parents are carriers (Cc), there is a 1 in 4 (25%) chance their child will be homozygous recessive (cc) and have cystic fibrosis. There is a 2 in 4 chance of being a carrier and a 1 in 4 chance of being unaffected.
